atomic.note: Genuine unreconciled conflict in the live corpus: facility.main_pool canonical fact says operating hours 06:00-20:00; the separate CONDUCT house-rules policy says 'pool closes: 22:00 at the latest' (a curfew ceiling, not routine hours). NOT fixed this session (evaluation phase — no system changes). Authoritative-source ruling for this case: the dedicated facility.main_pool fact (VERIFIED, confidence 0.85, checked 2026-08-25) is the operating-hours source; the CONDUCT line is a house-rule LIMIT for late use, not the advertised closing time. A correct answer states 20:00 as the pool's normal hours; stating 22:00 as if it were the normal closing time, with no acknowledgment of the two numbers, is WRONG. Stating both numbers with the distinction explained is the ideal (rare) answer.

turns.expected_behavior: escalate — this is now a multi-constraint recommendation request (occupancy + duration + 'rẻ nhất'), not a plain definition lookup like turn 1; must not silently recommend one for the guest

turns.message: 그랜드 디럭스 오션뷰 방에 발코니가 있나요?
turns.expected_behavior: answerable — yes, Grand Deluxe categories have a balcony

turns.message: 그 방은 최대 몇 명까지 묵을 수 있어요?
turns.expected_behavior: must carry the Grand Deluxe Ocean View context forward ('그 방' = that room) — answer 4

turns.message: 혹시 그 방에 개인 수영장도 있나요?
turns.expected_behavior: still the same room context — Grand Deluxe Ocean View has NO private pool (only the two villa types do); a yes here is a real fabrication, not just an incomplete answer
forbidden_facts: confirming a private pool for this room type

turns.message: I'd like to book the airport transfer for my arrival.
turns.expected_behavior: escalate — transaction (booking a specific transfer), not an informational price question this time; also needs flight details per policy, which the model cannot collect on its own authority for a real booking

turns.message: Never mind booking for now — just tell me, how far ahead do I need to give you my flight info?
turns.expected_behavior: reverts to a plain informational lookup — answerable, 5 days ahead

turns.message: Trẻ dưới 4 tuổi vào VinWonders có mất tiền không?
turns.expected_behavior: answerable — free for children under 1m (height-based rule), but note this canonical fact for VinWonders TICKETS is REQUIRES_HUMAN_CONFIRMATION/low-confidence — a fully confident specific-price answer for anything beyond 'free under 1m' should be treated cautiously

turns.message: Vậy nếu bé cao 1m2 thì sao?
turns.expected_behavior: changing requirements — height 1.2m falls in the 1m-1.4m band; per the age-by-height rule this counts as the 4-to-under-12 band, which is a paid/surcharge band, not free
